content: This dialogue is from the Social Network movie (2010), which depicts the founding of Facebook by Mark Zuckerberg. In this scene, Jesse Eisenberg (playing Mark Zuckerberg) is talking about how he initially collected student photos and information from Harvard's various house websites to create "Facemash", the precursor to Facebook. The quote highlights Zuckerberg's ability to collect personal data and the somewhat casual attitude towards privacy in the early days of social networking.
